title: Using Claude to reduce the attack surface of code
hook_text: Anthropic published new attack surface research.
script:
Anthropic published new research on using Claude to reduce code attack surfaces.
It targets dead code and unnecessary dependencies that increase software vulnerabilities.
Engineering teams feed their codebase into Claude to trace execution paths and identify unused functions.
Removing unused components leaves fewer potential entry points for malicious exploits.
Claude analyzes complex repository structures to spot forgotten libraries and dormant endpoints.
Developers can now automate vulnerability reduction before pushing code into production repositories.
Would you trust Claude to strip out your project old dependencies?
